column1: # The ESCAPE HATCH, and nothing else. Empty is the normal state.
# This lane's subject is the REFERENCE HAND PORT's own MUnit suite run against the mechanically
# emitted `sge.ai.*` (`PROGRESS.md` §10.7.12). It runs NO migration, so it has no
# `run-latest/dropped-types.tsv` and nothing here can be DERIVED — which is exactly why the row
# below has to be stated rather than left to a mechanism, and exactly why it is a claim someone
# has to defend.
# THE ROW IS ONE FACT, AND IT IS A `Miss` SHAPE THE ENGINE HAS NOT GOT. `Task.cloneTask()` in java
# instantiates the task reflectively (`com.badlogic.gdx.utils.reflect.ClassReflection.newInstance`);
# this port keys that on a `Class`-value registry whose declared `miss` REPRODUCES the JVM's own
# reflection (`RegistryTransform`, `ENGINE-LIMITS.md` P10), so a task with a nilary constructor now
# clones exactly as java does. `CountingTask` has no nilary constructor: java raised a
# `ReflectionException` and `cloneTask` wrapped it in the `TaskCloneException` its contract
# declares, where the miss arm answers `null` and `copyTo(null)` raises an NPE. `Miss` offers
# `Null`, `Throw` and `JvmReflect`, and no arm that reflects AND restates java's throw; `Throw`
# alone refuses a self-clone outright (`registry(self-clone)`).
# The REFERENCE port answers the same question differently: it added a `newInstance()` member to
# `Task` so that cloning needs no reflection at all. That is a REDESIGN of the library's surface,
# not a translation of it — so this test asserts the hand port's answer against the mechanical
# port's, and java's own source is the oracle where the two disagree. The suite's fixtures still
# DECLARE `newInstance()` (mapping row M7 drops only the `override` keyword, since this port's
# `Task` has no such member to override); what they cannot do is make this port's `cloneTask()`
# call it.
# WHAT WOULD MAKE THIS ROW WRONG. If `Miss` gains a reflective arm that restates java's throw, or
# the port gains a `TASK_CLONER` default, this test passes and `test-failures.tsv` reports the
# declared row for deletion. If a DIFFERENT failure appeared, `frame=` stops holding and it counts
# UNEXPECTED — which is the whole reason the frame is here.
# `test` may be `*` to declare a whole suite.
#suite
sge.ai.btree.TaskSuite
column3: CountingTask declares no nilary constructor, so RegistryTransform's Miss.JvmReflect arm answers null where java raised ReflectionException and cloneTask wrapped it in TaskCloneException; counted as registry(guarded-call) on ai-measure -- ENGINE-LIMITS.md P10
